content.comment_body: Hello, I am using [article_no] with two expansion modules (230V, 4 inputs, 4 outputs). [product_name] [version_no] Firmware was updated today to [version_no], but the issue remains. On my local network, [product_name] allows me to reach the login page. From an external network, behind a router (GSM connection), when I enter the router's IP with proper port forwarding to the device on a fixed IP, I reach the login page, but get ERROR 601 after entering the login details. Has anyone found a solution for this? This has been ongoing for over a year. Thank you [user_name]
[user_name]: The issue seems to be that [product_name] cannot handle new browser updates. If possible, uninstalling the browser update might work as a temporary solution.

That does not seem to be the cause. On the local network, the browser works fine; the same browser from outside, through the router, gives issue 601. I am unable to resolve this, so I switched to [product_name] [version_no]. Once I update the routing with my internet provider, I will check if [version_no] works – the address for [product_name] has changed, so the existing routing path is no longer valid.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing persistent login errors (ERROR 601) when trying to remotely access [company_name] devices using [product_name] over GSM connections and routers with port forwarding. The problem continues despite firmware updates and appears to be related to remote access or network routing rather than browser compatibility. Local network access works fine, suggesting the issue is specific to remote connectivity and routing.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect consistent and reliable remote access to [product_name] devices via the web editor, regardless of browser updates or network changes.
